fullTextEN: Hello,
Do you know that in Chinese,

fullTextZH: 有许多许多字听起来很像很像，
fullTextEN: there are many, many words that sound very similar,

fullTextZH: 比如说：“你很棒”和“你很胖”，
fullTextEN: for example: 'You are great' and 'You are fat',

fullTextZH: “你很棒”的意思是，你很好、很厉害，
fullTextEN: the meaning of 'You are great' is that you are good and awesome,

fullTextZH: 可是“你很胖”的意思是，你有很多很多肉。
fullTextEN: but the meaning of 'You are fat' is that you have a lot of flesh.

fullTextZH: 所以这两个句子的意思不一样，
fullTextEN: So the meanings of these two sentences are different,
very different.
I have a student,

fullTextZH: 他说他不喜欢说“你很棒”，
fullTextEN: he says he doesn't like to say 'You are great',
because he is very worried about saying it wrong,

fullTextZH: 如果他不小心说了“你很胖”，
fullTextEN: if he accidentally says 'You are fat',
then others might be unhappy!
So this student of mine,
he avoids using 'You are great' as much as possible,
because he is very worried about saying it wrong,
and then he might say
'You are fat'.

fullTextZH: 好，最近我的学生去了台湾，
fullTextEN: Okay, recently my student went to Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 然后有一天，他住在台湾的山上，
fullTextEN: and then one day, he was staying in the mountains of Taiwan,
It's very cold, very cold on the mountain at night,
It's about 4 degrees.

fullTextZH: 突然，他看到一个台湾人穿了一件背心，
fullTextEN: Suddenly, he saw a Taiwanese person wearing a vest,

fullTextZH: 对，穿一点点衣服，不是很多，
fullTextEN: Yes, wearing a little clothing, not much,
Wearing a vest.

fullTextZH: 所以我的学生想要夸夸（to praise）他。
fullTextEN: So my student wanted to praise him.

fullTextZH: 我的学生想要说“你很棒！”
fullTextEN: My student wanted to say, 'You're great!'
But then a problem arose,

fullTextZH: 这个台湾人他真的有一点胖！
fullTextEN: This Taiwanese person is indeed a bit chubby!

fullTextZH: 这个台湾人差不多200多斤，
fullTextEN: This Taiwanese person is about 200 jin,
which is over 100 kilograms.

fullTextZH: 对，所以他真的有一点胖。
fullTextEN: Yes, so he is indeed a bit chubby.
If my student said it wrong,
then there might be a problem.
But my student is very brave,
Hmm!

fullTextZH: 他鼓起勇气（muster his courage），对这个台湾人说：“你很棒！”
fullTextEN: He mustered his courage and said to the Taiwanese person, 'You're great!'

fullTextZH: 那这个台湾人没有生气，
fullTextEN: Then the Taiwanese person didn't get angry,
didn't hit him,

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得我的学生他说对了。
fullTextEN: so I think my student said it right.

fullTextZH: 我觉得很多很多人学了中文，
fullTextEN: I think many, many people have learned Chinese,

fullTextZH: 可是很怕和中国人说话，
fullTextEN: but they are very afraid to speak with Chinese people,
because they are afraid of making mistakes,

fullTextZH: 他们也怕听不懂中国人说的东西。
fullTextEN: they are also afraid of not understanding what Chinese people say.
But I want to say:
Don't be afraid,

fullTextZH: 因为如果中国人听到外国人说中文，
fullTextEN: because if Chinese people hear foreigners speaking Chinese,
we are very happy~
we are very glad,
so don't be afraid.

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得没有人会打你，
fullTextEN: Because I think no one will hit you,

fullTextZH: 如果你告诉中国人：“不好意思，我听不懂，”
fullTextEN: if you tell Chinese people: "Sorry, I don't understand,"
"Sorry,
I am still learning Chinese,"
Hmm. Or,
"Sorry,
my Chinese is not very good yet,"

fullTextZH: 或者你说：“啊，你慢一点儿说。”
fullTextEN: or you say: "Ah, speak a bit slower."

fullTextZH: 对，如果你告诉中国人你是外国人，
fullTextEN: Yes, if you tell Chinese people you are a foreigner,
you are still learning Chinese,

fullTextZH: 可能现在你的听力不太好，
fullTextEN: Maybe your listening skills aren't very good right now,

fullTextZH: 可能现在你说得不太好，
fullTextEN: Maybe you don't speak very well right now,

fullTextZH: 我相信中国人一定不会介意（to mind），
fullTextEN: I believe Chinese people definitely won't mind,

fullTextZH: 我觉得中国人一定会帮你。
fullTextEN: I think Chinese people will definitely help you.
So I hope you all

fullTextZH: 去和很多很多中国人练习中文。
fullTextEN: go practice Chinese with many, many Chinese people.

fullTextZH: 你和中国人说中文的时候，
fullTextEN: When you speak Chinese with Chinese people,
Have you ever, because you said something wrong,

fullTextZH: 或者你听错了，然后产生了误会（cause misunderstanding）呢？
fullTextEN: or you heard wrong, then caused a misunderstanding?
If there is,
please tell me your story.
Okay, see you next time, bye!
